ACTION=A2
The ego vehicle is traveling at 50 kph (~13.9 m/s) and a vehicle is cutting in from the right (y=3.5m) to the ego's lane (y=0m) starting at x=19m. The cut-in duration is 1.6s, meaning the vehicle will complete the maneuver around t=1.9s. At that time, the ego vehicle will have traveled approximately 26.4m, while the cutting-in vehicle will be at x = 19 + 7*1.6 = 30.2m. The relative speed is low (ego is faster), but the lateral intrusion into the ego's path requires a defensive response. Given the proximity and the fact that the ego is faster, maintaining speed (A0) or accelerating (A1) is unsafe. Braking hard (A3/A4) is excessive for a 1.6s cut-in with a 4m gap at completion. A moderate deceleration (A2) is the appropriate action to increase the following distance and ensure safety as the vehicle merges.
